svg.aria-label: Before: three platforms, each with its own interface, activity templates and data, each drawn with a different line. After: the exam prep platform and the general learning platform, which takes in the business content and moves to four shared templates, both built on a shared design system. Dotted: the single platform, second step, not yet under way.
